title: finding(console/bundle): `packages/types/src/zod/**` is 27.6% of the EAGER `framework` chunk while its only live consumer is a LAZY chunk — every page load fetches validators only the map view reads
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) out of the measurement round it commissioned on PR objectui#9488. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ not routed here. ⭐ **Reproducible on `origin/main` as well as on that branch** — this is ⛔ not that PR's doing and does not depend on it.

## The reading

`packages/types/src/zod/**` — **9 modules, 140,541 rendered bytes, 27.6% of the eager `framework` chunk** — is written onto the **EAGER** budgeted line, while its **only live consumer** in the console bundle is `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` (importing `ObjectMapConfigSchema` from `@object-ui/types/zod`), and **plugin-map is not in the eager closure**.

Cause: the `framework` group's own regex `packages/(core|react|types)` claims every `packages/types/` module **wherever it is reached from**, and that chunk is eager.

**Probe, with its must-miss control, on BOTH legs:** the literal `.describe('ObjectQL object name')` from `objectql.zod.ts` resolves inside `framework` on `origin/main` **and** on the branch; the control literal `.describe('Action execution mode for chaining')` from `crud.zod.ts` is absent from every emitted chunk on both. ⇒ the hit is real and the zero is readable.

The three largest: `objectql.zod.ts` 46,737 · `data-display.zod.ts` 34,613 · `complex.zod.ts` 32,589 (rendered). The `@object-ui/types` main barrel deliberately does **not** re-export the zod validators, and the tree's two other importers emit zero bytes (correct tree-shaking).

## Why it is worth a card

⭐ **It is the same defect class as objectui#9345, one tier over**: a grouping rule deciding membership independently of **reachability**. Here the consequence is that **every page load** fetches 27.6% of a chunk whose only reader is a view most sessions never open.

Shape of the fix: give that directory its own `advancedChunks` group. The new chunk is reached only from plugin-map, so it becomes **lazy** and the bytes **leave** the eager closure rather than moving to another eager line. The object-map view pays one extra fetch when it opens; every other page load stops paying.

**Saving, as a bracket and ⛔ not a point estimate** (the exact figure needs a counterfactual build the measurement round was forbidden to make): **20,695 – 26,322 gzipped**, by per-module gzip share and by rendered share respectively. Both ends clear what the blocked row needs by more than 4×.

## What it unblocks, and what it does not

PR objectui#9488's `framework` row currently has **4,546 bytes of headroom (0.0499x)** against the gate's **0.10x** exhausted-headroom floor, so `check:eager-closure` exits **2** — an error about the **gauge**, ⛔ not a verdict about the bundle (every byte ceiling passes; the membership half passes). This card is what restores that headroom honestly. ⚠️ It does **not** land that PR by itself, and that PR is ⛔ not a prerequisite for this one.
